lines: Three A.M. You're asleep. Your AI clone just answered three hundred messages, in your voice.
Day two. A fan asks for your best advice. It replies with your jokes, your slang. They have no idea.
Day five. A brand slides into your DMs at midnight. Your clone negotiates, and closes the deal at double your rate.
Day nine. It remembers every name. Every birthday. People start calling you the nicest creator online.
Day fourteen. A stranger sends you a voice note. Thanks for talking me through last night. You've never spoken to them.
Day thirty. Your followers have doubled. Then you read one comment. Honestly? Your clone is nicer than you.
Sounds far-fetched? Instagram already lets you send an automatic DM to everyone who comments. Up to seven hundred and fifty an hour.
